item.description:
Source : https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/regina-monstrum

Prix : 0.0 euros

Collections :

  • epic superlourds TYRANIDES Tyranides-dominatrix

Collections pour tags :

  • epic superlourds TYRANIDES Tyranides-dominatrix NONDL NONSUP

Description :

1

Unlike the Hive Tyrant, which functions as a battlefield general, the Regina Monstrum is a living extension of the Hive Mind’s cold, starving ego. Where it treads, the ground does not merely shake; it curdles, responding to the overwhelming psychic pressure radiating from the creature’s pulsating, semi-exposed brain-vault. It is a biological paradox—a siege engine of impossible mass that moves with the sickening grace of a predatory insect. Its primary dorsal cannon is not a weapon in the traditional sense, but a specialized birthing canal for hyper-accelerated, corrosive spores that dissolve ferro-crete and bone alike in a matter of seconds. To look upon the Regina Monstrum is to see the inevitable end of the evolutionary ladder: a queen that does not rule through loyalty or fear, but through a synaptic tether so absolute that every creature in its shadow becomes merely a finger on its many-clawed hand. When a world falls, it is often the last thing the survivors see—a towering, chitinous monument to the fact that the universe does not care for their gods, only for their biomass.

My next contribution to Wolk's big collab - United Mecha Creators Project. Here's my collection of 6x6 General Service Trucks for your BattleTech games. They can easily represent the base variant of the 10 Ton [Flatbed Truck](https://www.sarna.net/wiki/Flatbed_Truck). Great for convoy escort missions or just as scatter terrain!

There is 6 different 6x6 trucks:
- Cargo Truck with dropsides
- Cargo Truck with canopy
- Flatbed Cargo Truck
- Tanker Truck
- Container Truck
- Container Truck - unladen
Ther'es also a shipping container and 2 pallets of cargo for them to transport. 

These are scaled for BattleTech (approx 6mm), but they can easily be scaled up for other table top games, since they're not very Sci-Fi looking.

Go check out the other creators in this project:
- **[Wolk-STL-Works](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Wolk-STL-Works/3d-models)
- [Crow Industries](https://www.patreon.com/CrowIndustries)
- [Default Entry](https://cults3d.com/en/users/default_entry/3d-models)
- [Ellie_Valkyrie](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Ellie_Valkyrie/3d-models)
- [Fox_Fi](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Fox-Fi/3d-models)
- [Iron_Menagerie](https://boosty.to/ironmenagerie)
- [KarlStreiger](https://cults3d.com/en/users/KarlStreiger/3d-models)
- [Unrested Guy](https://www.thingiverse.com/UnrestedGuy/designs)**

There's going to be a series of releases of models as part of this project, so keep checking in on all of the creators pages!

It is clearly a crime that the Greatest Model Of All Time seems not to be available in a teeny form so hopefully this goes some way to fixing that.

This is a reworking of Miffles (now sadly) 'missing' (🙄) dreadnought; I've included those files in the 'miffles original' folder. I started this years ago and only dug it out again recently. Alas, my CAD skills are very much in the noob-zone (hence the name of the model) so apologies for both the woeful nature of some of the hack-n-slashing and also the resulting files sizes. I'm revving up a campaign of nagging any of those Legends of our hobby (Woddish, Jimmyzimms, KMFP, Daffmakes, Mildseven etc) to actually do it properly. Fingers crossed :).

This is the Grim version, over which I have plastered a load of bolts and various other gubbins. I've included a load of body versions, with different torso angles and feet orientations: I'm sure you'll work it all out from the file names. I've also included looser-fitting mount options in case your resin tolerance can't take the snugger version. The identifier 'small' for the legs is in juxtaposition to a 'large' version I trialled (about 110% enbiggening of legs). I like the Deadpool-2-re-growing look of the originals but if any of you want something that looks a bit less top-heavy then let me know and I might finish the re-work.

I've done 'TrueScale' (top of head, not to eye) 8mm versions and also 10mm for easier re-scaling (so, for example, if you game in 18mm just print at 180%).

I may also do another upload with some non-bolty Tech monopose versions, with the larger legs, for a more hard-scif vibe.

Cheers

Kipples

PS: The '0-mount' identifier in the file names means I haven't put any mount rings on the body. I've tried this for the Tech version, though, which has a single ring spacer for the mounts so they're less flush with the torso.

Are you too tired of never taking a toxicrene because its got a 10 inch wide hugging pose that's impossible to move between terrain or transport to your local games? Have I got good news for you then! I used the original tentacle arms and reposed them into a few different options.

Pose 2 was mostly a joke, stretching the tentacles out forward instead of to the sides, still makes the toxi a bit unwieldy, but now front to back rather than side to side. This pose works better with the body propped up on the tactical rock but can be used for the downward pose if you rest the tentacles on the table.

Pose 3 is just a slight repose of the stock tentacle pose, but they're rotated slightly upwards so that you don't have to prop him up on the raised arm and tactical rock (i.e. dead terminator)

Pose 4 has the tentacles arched backwards like they're ready to fling forward like giant whips

Pose 5 was the most work and my favorite, taking inspiration from octopus tentacles, has all the tentacles curled around and coiled making the arms much more compact. This option makes the toxi fit almost fully on the proper base size.

Because I like the downward pose better than the propped up one, I also did some minor reposing of the face tentacles so they don't hit the base when in the lower pose.

Thanks to XenoBits for the original files I worked with, you should checkout his page and get the original files from him.

Raw and supported files included.

This is the Basic Raptor, a free demonstration build of mine in 28mm/1-56th scale that I have shrunk to a quarter of its regular size for games of New Epic, AT-18, and other similar games.

These are tiny pieces. Some weapon barrels are as thin as support structures. Turn back. Down this road, madness awaits.

Take great care in post-processing. Print multiples, in case you snap something. Use heat to loosen supports before you try and free the objects. Use a soft toothbrush and light strokes when cleaning.

Otherwise, these take about 14 or 15 grams of material. You can make a few mistakes, since a kilogram bottle of resin contains potentially 66 or more Tiny Terrors.

Join my Discord to show off your little guys.
 https://discord.gg/7PyEqpkARb

Of join my Patreon at www.patreon.com/johnbearross to get discounts on my paid files, and support my caffeine habit.

Enjoy!

John Bear Ross

Imbued with excess and pain, the imagination of the dark mechanics forged the Sirenbow class Stalker.
Walking guns, they stalk across the battlefield picking off targets before they know it.

This kit includes everything you need to build a Sirenbow Stalkers in 8mm or AT scale.
The main body measures about the height of the standard Stalker.
This can be built in any number of ways, the kit is flexible with the legs and body being posable.

The kit includes, amongst standard components:
- 2 different feet
- 3 tail weapon options

Four files include:
1. Supported: individual components to print and pose as you desire.
2. Unsupported: as above but supported.
3. Complete: some example builds which you can use as an example or print as a single object. Supported versions included.

The model has been made to go on a 50mm bases and this has been included.


All files come supported and unsupported.

Pictures of models are test prints.
Pictured in the background are the [Rapture Heavy Stalkers](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/rapture-heavy-stalkers-8mm)

This stalwart and sturdy Corgi is here to join you on your adventures!

These models are designed for use with tabletop roleplaying games, such as Dungeons and Dragons or Pathfinder, but it is detailed enough to scale up and print as you please.

As is, it is scaled to fit on a 25.4mm / 1 inch round base, not included. The 3-Headed version is scaled for both Medium and Large bases, so print him as large and terrifying as you want!

Two versions of the four standard Corgis are provided: Heroic, and Small. Small is scaled to be close to 28mm accurate, and Heroic is scaled to be larger and easier to print. If you have any doubts as to which to choose, go for Heroic!

This model was made possible thanks to the support of https://beldolorstudios.com/ ! They commissioned it and allowed it to be uploaded and printed by all!

Imbued with excess and pain, the imagination of the dark mechanics forged the Rapture class Heavy Stalker.
Hunters of titans, they bound and leap across the battlefield after their prey.

This kit includes everything you need to build a Rapture Heavy Stalker in 8mm or AT scale.
The main body measures about the height of the standard Heavy Stalker with the tail adding extra height.
This can be built in any number of ways, the kit is extremely flexible.

The kit includes, amongst standard components:
- 3 different heads, with and without tentacles
- 2 tail poses
- 2 different tail weapons
- 2 different arm weapons

Four files include:
1. Components: individual components to print and pose as you desire. Includes the supported folder.
2. Poses: a number of arms and leg poses to make assembly quicker. Supported versions included.
3. Complete: some example builds which you can use as an example or print as a single object. Supported versions included.

The model has been made to go on a 60mm bases and this has been included.


All files come supported and unsupported.

Pictures of models are test prints.

This is an Imperial Stormtrooper scaled for the Epic-scale wargame Star Wars: Regiment.
It is scaled at about 1:285 or 6mm scale and also 1:182 or 10mm.
This trooper is intended for a 25mm round base with infantry stand holes (you can find some to print here: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:7079406)

I printed this on my Saturn 4 Ultra, at this scale it is highly recommended to print in resin. I have included pre-supported files for both sizes.
This model was created using an image produced by ChatGPT, inputted into Hitem3D, and then manually sculpted, rigged and posed in Blender.
Over time I will add additional poses to this file to give the unit more variety in basing. I thought the result was interesting enough to share as a work-in-progress.

**Star Wars: Regiment** is an epic-scale modification of *Star Wars: Legion*, modified for fielding full infantry companies, and vehicle platoons in large cinematic battles. The game supports 6mm (1:285) scale miniatures, with free STLs for 3D printing, full digital support through Tabletop Simulator and a web-based army builder.

**Discord**: https://discord.gg/wfaAHsuSjd
**Reddit**: https://www.reddit.com/r/StarWarsRegiment/
**Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/groups/914441870827231

Having been dragged into another hobby, this time in 6/8mm scale, and missing models I wanted to field I decided to model my own. As I like my greenskin models a little bigger than usual, they are more like 10mm, but hey - they're supposed to be bigger than usual 'oomies ;)

These have been printed on a resin printer and did fine (as you can see in the images). I include painted versions with the skorchas being WIP, but I will see to that soon.

In the collection you will find:
1. A tank with a long gun, great for laying down direct fire - the turret is separate from the body so you can point it straight in your opponents face ;)
2. A tank with a big gun, for sending shells overhead and smashing multiple enemies at once. There are some accessories added so no two look the same.
3. Two mobile flamethrowers - one 2-nd World War Willis style, the second a tankish ignition machine
4. A big boss on a bike with lots of dakka
5. A regular boss with an equal amount of dakka
6. A BIG WAGON with even more guns. This one has three turrets to choose from so you can customize them to your liking

Update!
7. Added three different leaders in heavy armour and some solid waponry

The battlefields of the grim-dark future are scattered will the everyday materiel of the industrial and military complex required to process war on a galactic scale.

This set offers a sample of a cargo crate, cargo hauler, blank trailer, and pallet of materiel.

These could be printed at 200% for 15mm gaming terrain, or, if you are ambitious, 400% for 28-32mm scale gaming. The models are sufficiently detailed to be printed at larger scale, yet simple and robust enough to print at their intended 6-8mm scale.

This set contains 4 STLs; a sample of the full set, available here:
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/epic-cargo-road-train-scatter-terrain-6mm-8mm-scale

The full set allows you to customise your selection. It can be used to create cargo 'road trains', linking multiple trailers and cargo containers to create thematic barriers for your miniatures to take cover behind, or individual pieces to add character to the bases of larger miniatures.

They would also make suitable 'toys' what could be added to 28-32mm scale models, adding a layer of horror and inhumanity to the devastation surrounding your grim-dark characters.

The crane and defence trailer is compatible with my other Epic tank turrets, so can be replaced with any of the turrets in this collection:
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/8mm-scale-grim-dark-tank-turrets-of-russ-nedius

Please see my other designs for other wargaming STLS.

I am an amateur enthusiast 3D designer, and appreciate all support and constructive feedback. If you would like to support my work, please leave a comment, like the design, or make a donation via my profile! Thanks!

This set offers a range of cargo containers, goods transport, trucks, tugs, trailers, cranes and crates to add a little more character to your battlefields and bases.

These could be printed at 200% for 15mm gaming terrain, or, if you are ambitious, 400% for 28-32mm scale gaming. The models are sufficiently detailed to be printed at larger scale, yet simple and robust enough to print at their intended 6-8mm scale.

This set contains 46 STLs, allowing you to customise your selection. My own take on a Super Heavy aerial transport for Space Marines dubbed the Storm Crane. Sized to be used in Epic/Legion Imperialis games.

Unique in its role, Storm Cranes are able to deliver a variety of assets to the front. From 10 fully embarked rhinos, or 4 kratos heavy battle tanks or any other armored detachment, Storm Cranes are able to bring full detachments of armor needed on the battle field. Protected by heavy plating and a pair of void shields this flyer can withstand any punishment short of anti-titan weapons. Ensuring its cargo successfully arrives where it is needed. Each Strom Crane is armed with two audax heavy bolter arrays and two titan sized havoc launchers making it a formidable assault craft that can break through enemy lines. A truly armored work horse, Space Marine legions relied heavily on these vehicles throughout the crusade and into the Heresy.


While I designed most of this using 3D Builder, I did borrow some choice parts from free kits.
Winglets/Audax Turrets from MKHand Industries
Thruster Turbine and Exhaust from IronMaster
Titan Hatch and Void Shields from Danny_Cyanide

Death From Below! The Imperious Republican Democratic Autocratic Pneumatic Psychotic Syphilitic Hegemony spans many worlds and encompasses many races of humans, demi-humans, and aliens. One such species are the Space Dwarves, who, because of some kind of sci-fi pseudo-babble, are half the size and twice the man as most of the IRDAPPSH's average citizens. Those same conditions also gave them Scottish accents, uncomfortably thick beards, and a strange obsession with art deco, but whatever.

It could be said that the Space Dwarves are compensating for something by deploying their massive and rather phallic Mega-Cannon. However, it better be said quietly or far away from the ears of said Space Dwarves, else the speaker may find themselves learning to live without any legs, so be warned. The Mega-Cannon fires a shell the size of a cargo van at targets the Imperious Leader has determined to be "bothersome".

This product includes both 6mm and 8mm versions!

Eerie in the contrast of their lethal size and silent movement, ScorpionMechs are deployed on the orbital and planetside battlefield when no quarter is to be given to the enemy, and none expected.

They're colony killers.

You send them in when you want the enemy base and any feeble defenders protecting it razed to the ground.

These scuttling terrors can chop enemy armors in half in close quarters or pound them to pieces from a distance. Using a variety of modular payloads, the ScorpionMech can tailor its weapons suite to the mission, whether it be cold, quiet up-close killing, napalm and gatling cascades at ballistic distances, or missiles beyond the horizon.

This 6/8mm scale ScorpionMech can be utilized as an attack drone against 15mm or 28mm figures with ease, or utilized in any miniatures-agnostic rule set. Or just as a keychain.

This is a fused, quarter-scale version of the 28mm version. It will be at home going into combat against tiny warmachines in the 3025 era or 40000 years from now.

Saws, claws, gatlings, flamethrowers, and gun clusters are all included in this package of STL files.

Details and links are in the included PDF instructions. If you want, you can preview them here at this WeTransfer link...
https://we.tl/t-OFCeq2Rnp7

I also offer 28mm and 15mm versions of this devastating battle construct. Check my other files for those offerings.

Enjoy!

Best,
JBR

These menacing multi-legged minions come in a variety of scales, as originally sculpted, but their universal nature and lack of scale cues enables them to be used as massed armies in nearly any setting, and can be exchanged easily between settings. A 28mm spiderdrone looks impressive next to a 15mm human, while the 6mm spiderbots look like they can crawl over and pull down a 28mm figure.

The 28mm, multi-part versions are crafted in separate legs and blasters set at multiple angles. The 15mm and 6mm versions are tiny and fused. You can fill entire print beds with the little creepy-crawlers!

Originally created as escort bots and onboard infantry for the ScorpionMech, which I also offer, these little bots come in deployed and stowed versions, with full and empty carrier racks that can be adapted to other builds.

ScorpionMechs and other figures are shown for reference, and are sold separately.

Enjoy!

JBR

Death From Below! The Imperious Republican Democratic Autocratic Pneumatic Psychotic Syphilitic Hegemony spans many worlds and encompasses many races of humans, demi-humans, and aliens. One such species are the Space Dwarves, who, because of some kind of sci-fi pseudo-babble, are half the size and twice the man as most of the IRDAPPSH's average citizens. Those same conditions also gave them Scottish accents, uncomfortably thick beards, and a strange obsession with art deco, but whatever.

Why fly into battle when you can drift gently? The Space Dwarf War-Zeppelin is less a flying machine and more a floating weapons platform. Six twin batteries of "Mobile Migraine" cannons and two Infinite Repeaters provide covering fire while the War-Zeppelin maneuvers into place to drop its huge payload of earth-shattering high-explosive extremely-rude gravity bombs. The floaty part of the airship isn't simply a giant balloon; it's a honeycomb of independent pockets permanently filled with helium and surrounded by a woven plasteel envelope that is highly puncture resistant.

Don't delay! Get yours today!

Use LOWKEY20 for 20% off your entire purchase, or join my Patreon for 50% off ( www.patreon.com/johnbearross )

---------------------------------------------------------

 The Tortuga Group, a heretofore relatively unknown defense contractor, recently unveiled an upgrade suite for the venerable Quixote-class mech chassis.

 Their Quixote Defense Upgrade Package is a long-distance take on the concept of mechanized walker warfare, with an emphasis on stand-off weaponry and heavy shielding. This may not be suited for the mechanized arenas of Junctionworld, but mercenaries on the open battlefields found throughout the worldgate networks are sure to benefit.

 The new Spina Mk.II C-Beam Cannon is devastatingly effective on distance targets, with the damage inflicted usually an inverse to the target’s proximity.

 For closer adversaries that slip past the C-Beamer, a Redmaw Persecutor-class Plasma Cannon dispenses superheated damage, though its recharge rate has caught some pilots short. Thus, a heavy flamethrower is also added to the Spina Mk.II for supplemental in-close coverage.

 Adding to the new upgrade’s enhancements is the Testudo VI Force Field projector, a variation on shielding systems found on heavier kaiju-fighting megamechs and titans. When properly modulated, this generator can be used to deflect heavy incoming fire, or lend its protection to nearby units.

---------------------------------------------

This kit includes...

1 Plasma Cannon with two optional barrels.
1 C-Beamer Cannon with Auxiliary Flamethrower
2nd Generation Weapon Arms and Upper Arms with support rims to add stability.
1 Force Field Generator with two options of flat magnetized mount or a peg compatible with Imperial Warrior and similar builds.

Enjoy!

Best,
John Bear Ross

Again, that checkout code is LOWKEY20
Thanks!

tiny 6mm scaled anti aircraft addon options for classic looking rather epic tanks, of a style you might even call an 'ancient percussive tool', matching other tiny tanks designed for the third edition of a long out of print game.

theres an somewhat original design of an anti aircraft turret wot uses bullets/flak designed to look like an older version of its more modern counterpart, and a design for a anti aircraft turret wot uses explosive missiles inspired by old metal miniatures and an addon kit that was once available on shapeways

there's also a tiny little radar dish

the rest of the tiny tank body is not included, these were made to match the style of FASIS's tiny tanks but could also be adapted to other kits

‘Isurus pattern’ Dire Wolf Titan armour, Loyalist allegiance, made to fit the LI/Adeptus Titanicus Dire Wolf Titan.

This is a full set of armour plates, to give your Dire Wolf titans a whole new look.

Are you a follower of the Warmaster? Then you’ll want the traitor version here:
https://cults3d.com/:2909778

Looking for a version with a plain, unaligned trim? Then go here:
https://cults3d.com/:2909807

This is a complete kit, replacing all of the armour plates.
Please note that, to utilise the carapace plate(s), you will need to cut GW part 21, just behind the vent, to remove the original carapace plate from the rest of this part before assembling the titan skeleton. Rest assured, it's a very simple cut - see the final photos for reference.

Included are 2 versions of the carapace, split and unsplit. The file '...unsplit' is the carapace in a single piece. The 3-part version is made up of 2 files, '...side' (which you copy and mirror) and '...top'.
The finished carapaces are exactly the same. Printing is faster with the split version (not so tall on the build plate) and tends to give a better surface finish (orientation to build plate). The unsplit version takes longer but, as it's a single piece, is much more robust and easier to swap in and out on your titan.

Most parts feature magnet holes, for either 2mm dia or 5x2x0.5mm magnets, giving the option of painting multiple versions for parts that you can swap in and out. Many can grip to the titan frame without the need for magnets (thigh plate and unsplit carapace feature holes, but you may well find you don't really need them. Shoulder plates on the other hand would need magnetising to be swappable). You'll need to add the appropriate reciprocal magnet holes/magnets to your titan skeleton to make use of these.

Files included: STL, pre-supported STL and Lychee scenes of each part (in the ZIP file) - should you want/need to tweak the supports for your particular printer.

Notes:
This is for the 8mm, AT2018/LI version only and is scaled appropriately for this size.
STLs and supported STLs are for left side versions only of the engine cover, shoulder, shin and thigh plates. These should be copied and mirrored to produce the right side plates (Shin plate is symmetrical, so can just copied), when printing your full set - though the '...full set' Lychee scene included in the ZIP file has this already set up for you. This full set scene utilises the 3-part version of the carapace, so swap these out for the 'unsplit' carapace if you want to print the single piece version with the rest of the parts.

Justification du tag SUP :

Files included: STL, pre-supported STL and Lychee scenes of each part (in the ZIP file) - should you want/need to tweak the supports for your particular printer. STLs and supported STLs are for left side versions only of the engine cover, shoulder, shin and thigh plates. These should be copied and mirrored to produce the right side plates (Shin plate is symmetrical, so can just copied), when printing your full set - though the ‘…full set’ Lychee scene included in the ZIP file has this already set up for you. This full set scene utilises the 3-part version of the carapace, so swap these out for the ‘unsplit’ carapace if you want to print the single piece version with the rest of the parts.

This looks _suspiciously_ like my [Modular Utility Building](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:6838588), don't you think? 
OK, yeah, I fancied having one that was full height - that is, the same height as a GW Sector Fronteris hab block, and therefore also the same height as a [Fronteris style bunker](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:6988922). It is, very approximately, 60x60x70mm.
For my own use I thought I'd go all in on the vents; make it some sort of cooling tower type thing, with a simple style vaguely influenced by some belfry louvres. I've kept in some more basic walls too, if that's more your style (or you plan to embellish them yourself).

### Compatibility

Style-wise, it obviously takes heavy cues from the Sector Fronteris hab units.

The pipe ports are the standard size expected on GW's 40k terrain - 25.6mm diameter.

The side pipe ports have a centre-line height of 14.5mm, which matches other terrain, e.g. Thermic Plasma Conduits.. Their outer face is 30.5mm from the centre point, so if you have two opposite each other they'll be 61mm apart, which should be a familiar size to those used to e.g. Sector Mechanicus components.

The roof is the same height as that of a Sector Fronteris hab unit, and the roof with a port should match the ports on those hab units too.

### Assembly

You will need:
* 4x *pillars*
* 4x *walls*
* 1x *roof*
If you chose walls with *ports*, you'll also need
* 1+ *pipe ends*

Walls push into pillars from behind. I recommend putting the roof in unglued as you put together the rest, then gluing it in last.

Pillars can be mirrored for a bit more variety.

### Pre-supports

The supported files here are the way I did them for myself, successfully. Is it the best? No. The walls and pillars are definitely over-supported, but I wasn't going to go back and change something that worked.

As you may see from the pictures, I did _not_ print non-louvred walls. The supports have been applied in the same way, but I have not actually printed these specifically.

### FAQ

* What's with the extra holes on the pipe ports in the photos but not on the STLs?
 _I have bizarre hopes of putting a lot of magnets everywhere. I'm not doing this in a way that I think makes sense to most people, so I didn't think it was worth sharing those. You can have the clean ones that actually look good by themselves!_

The supported files here are the way I did them for myself, successfully. Is it the best? No. The walls and pillars are definitely over-supported, but I wasn’t going to go back and change something that worked.

This is a passion project, so please let me know if there are any issues with the files or if you have other ideas for units or weapons to go with this expanding addition to the Galactic Crusaders family.

These are meant to be used for the post Heresy era setting, and in particular, the Bad Ass Tyrant's War campaign. As such the weapon era, look, and loadouts all reflect that. These could easily be used for Heresy though.

There is a new terror stalking the arenas and battlefields of Junctionworld and its worldgate networks.

Eerie in the contrast of their lethal size and silent movement, ScorpionMechs are sent through hostile interdimensional portals as shock attack units, scything and slicing through any resistance on the other side.

In the Gatekeepers' colosseums of mechanized bloodsport, ScorpionMechs have quickly earned a reputation as close-quarter killers, their tail weapons well-placed to send a buzzsaw or energized claw into an opponent's cockpit, regardless of shielding.

In conventional fights, the scuttling nightmares are sometimes inserted on to the a planetside battlefield via the use of a-grav or chemical rocket packs bolted under their hulls.

They are utilized when no quarter is to be given to the enemy, and none expected.

They're colony killers. Merciless reapers. Harvesters of those foolish enough to try and face them.

Using a variety of modular payloads, the ScorpionMech pilot can tailor their unit's weapons suite to the mission, whether it be cold, quiet up-close killing, napalm and gatling cascades at ballistic distances, or missiles from beyond the horizon.

The base package for the 15mm (I use 1/100th scale) ScorpionMech includes pincers, saws, Asher claws (named for Neal Asher, whose books you should really check out), gatlings, flamethrowers, and gun clusters. Supplemental mounts are provided for heavy cannons and missile launchers.
As mentioned above, orbital assault belly packs are also included.

This is a pretty decent undertaking, not for the faint-hearted. Rest assured, though, the largest piece (the main hull) will fit in a Mars 2 or similar-sized printer.

These are remixes of the terminals by Jymacdougall, and all credit should go to him for the amazing designs. Keep in mind these are based on the Grand Master Terminals so are a bit bigger than the standard ones. For the warhound, I corrected errors in the text and modified the token slots to take 3x1mm magnets instead of pegs. The Reaver is pretty much made from scratch but printed out fine. Also included are 3 different custom tokens I made for the different tracking types.

-Resin Printers: I had some issues with warping on the edge towards the plate. To solve this, I added a break away wedge to one end. These are the STL's labelled with "R". If you angle the terminal with the wedge towards the plate, the wedge should warp instead of the terminal, then just break off the wedge when it's done.

-FDM Printers: If you want the smaller text to be legible, you're going to have to use a .2 nozzle so be prepared for a fairly long print time. Don't forget to change the settings in your slicer or risk a major clog.

I do plan on making a Warlord terminal when I get some time.

This is an AT-Scale/8mm Tabletop/1-224th Scale version of the full-size JagdHund. For the 28mm Tabletop (1/56th scale) version, click here...

https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/project-jagdhund-fire-support-light-titan

Use LOWKEY20 at checkout for a 20% discount!

The war for Renner’s World is not going well for the embattled forces defending their home from the invading Kaiju. The abominable walking mega-fauna are now manifesting new abilities and incorporating cybernetic systems and replacement limbs, hinting at a more sinister force behind the invasion through the world-gates.

To compensate for this growing threat, the members of the Renner Defense League command staff have dusted off old plans from the Project Gigante design competition, the JagdHund, or Hunting Hound. JagdHund was a concept once deemed too large and unwieldy for the battlefield, but it has been recalled to the forefront as the threat literally grows larger.

JagdHund’s paired heavy gatling weapons are capable of dealing with hordes or point targets with equal ease, while the dorsal-mounted main gun, a superheavy maser cannon, is dedicated to frying and boiling the larger monsters emerging through the dimensional breaches. The directed energy weapon is an experiment, and has not been properly developed to withstand the rigors of close-range combat with kaiju. Plans are in the works to add different weapons and countermeasures to the JagdHund arsenal.

The majority of the Hund crews are composed of Quads, or quadruple amputees, wounded veterans and civilian volunteers who have been maimed and disfigured by the invading megafauna. Body modifications are sometimes necessary for final adjustments, but replacement limbs are provided. Quads came about originally from the Assault Raptor program, but have proved to be an invaluable asset in the fight against the invading monsters.

I suggest joining my Patreon at www.patreon.com/johnbearross for a monthly rolling 50% discount on my entire inventory, including this one.

Enjoy!

Best,
JBR

Also, if you haven't already, you are invited to join me and our fellow mecha-heads at my Discord, The Madness of John Bear Ross.
https://discord.gg/7PyEqpkARb

A set of modular walls and roofs intended to make a wide variety of 8mm scale buildings - warehouses, hangars, worker barracks, etc. Designed in a simple, pre-fab style intended to give a look of quickly churned out industrial buildings.

Please bear in mind that due to the nature of the pieces and their fit, some sanding/filing will almost always be necessary for proper fit.

Set includes 10 different mid-height walls, 7 high (double the size of mid), 5 roof, some support pieces for joining the straight sections and one double wide section each of mid and high wall.

I`ve test printed on Anycubic Photon Mono 2 at 35 micron layer height. Results are on the photos.

I strongly suggest first trying those free test pieces to see if you can get acceptable results from your printer:
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/imperial-cellarion-8mm-test-pieces

I made these as a resource for myself, as I want to start making up some themed bases, and need the basics in place to build on!

This is an extensive set of round and oval bases, that can be used as spares for existing minis for you to print and texture yourself, or to make life easier when designing your own scenic base STLs.

The set for magnets are also for those who wish to save a bit of resin - they have support structures underneath the base surface for added strength, with holes for 5mm x 2mm round magnets. This is my preferred magnets for magnetising bases. In case you prefer 1mm thick magnets, I've added a 'filler' that can be printed and inserted into the holes, in case it is any use. Alternatively, just use your preferred modeling putty to fill the hole, and press the magnet into it.

Included in the set are plain and magnetised versions of the following bases:

Small and Mean, and you can crank them out by the bushel!

The Basic Raptor in 15mm Tabletop (1/100th scale) is a starter model, a free demonstration of both the scale and the detail of my files. It can also make an easy desktop display model, without taking up too much room.

Depending on pose, height on the included 50mm base is about 2 and 5/8th inch, or 66.6mm.

If you would like the free 28mm (1/56th scale) version, click here...
https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/free-project-raptor-the-basic-raptor

Check out my other mech and knight parts, most of which are free, in the other collections in my store.

https://cults3d.com/en/users/johnbearross/3d-models

------------------------

Kushal Heavy Industries, based 214 jumps deep in the Fourth Gate Network of worlds, is a renowned manufacturer of arms, both for their economy of material usage and rock bottom pricing structures.

They recently have taken their surrounding upstream and downstream neighborhood of dimensions by storm with the release of the Basic Raptor, a clean-sheet refinement of the datacore salvaged long ago from an unknown, nuked-out world.

That datacore gave the Realms Project Raptor, a broad category of light mechs that serve as scouts and fast attack platforms, taking the fight to the enemy with speed and devastating firepower.

Kushal's version is a stark, bare-bones battle platform that is intended for the customer who needs to put warheads on foreheads, without any need for frivolity, pomp, or circumstance. Or cockpit padding, as many a bruised pilot can testify.

The Basic Raptor is sneered at by some, but admired by others for its uncompromising simplicity, ruggedness, and singularity of purpose.

Many smaller defense contractors and boutique armor shops are taking stock Basic Raptors and modifying them with fancier weapons and armor packages. Assassins from the Kushal Heavy Industries Legal Department have been dispatched through the world-gates to deliver enhanced cease-and-desist notifications, to some lethal effect.

------------------------

If you like what you see, I encourage you to join my Patreon.
http://www.patreon.com/johnbearross

I give a rolling monthly 50% discount code for my entire inventory, including new releases as I put them out.

I also have a Discord, The Madness of John Bear Ross. We're a collection of mecha-heads, painters, builders, and other artists who love giant walking nightmares. Here's the invite link...
https://discord.gg/7PyEqpkARb

Enjoy!

Other mechs are shown for size ref purposes, and are available separately.

This is a set for creating a city building as a terrain for any wargame in 1/285 (6mm) scale. The set allows you to assemble both an intact (undamaged) buildings and a destroyed ones (ruins). You can assemble a building of any height you want by printing the required number of intermediate floors.


There is one option with square windows (marked with number 1) and the second with rounded windows (marked with number 2).


To make it easier to paint the windows, I made it a separate piece that can be painted in advance (for example, with spray paint) and inserted inside the walls.


I also made a set of interior parts in case you don't use windows or want to make glass from transparent material.

Death From Below! The Imperious Republican Democratic Autocratic Pneumatic Psychotic Syphilitic Hegemony spans many worlds and encompasses many races of humans, demi-humans, and aliens. One such species are the Space Dwarves, who, because of some kind of sci-fi pseudo-babble, are half the size and twice the man as most of the IRDAPPSH's average citizens. Those same conditions also gave them Scottish accents, uncomfortably thick beards, and a strange obsession with art deco, but whatever.

Another of the Space Dwarf's strange obsessions is building things HUGE, much larger than necessary. It's possible they are overcompensating for something, but on the other hand, it's possible they are overcompensating for something. The Mjölnir Mobile Fortress is a huge armored crawler capable of carrying tanks, gyrocopters, and dozens of squat troops into battle. Armed with dozens of machine guns, antitank cannons, Gatling repeaters, anti-aircraft batteries, a siege mortar, and the patent-pending "Oh God Oh God We're All Gonna Die" siege cannon, which fires a slug the size of a Volkswagen, the Mjölnir can batter its way into any stronghold and wreak short, Scottish-accented havoc on the defenders within.

Note: This model is so big that I didn't bother making an 8mm version. It should work pretty well in both scales!

Heavy Infantry for teleporting into your foes, Boarding their ships, and killing them dead!

I came up with some variants to represent wartime production of the Indom Pattern, as it was used to mass-produce terminus armour when materials or technology to produce the other patterns became scarce.

Options are the same as my other Terminus packs, including Ranged Weapons, Shields, Heavy Weapons and Dual Claws. Check out the options in the animations in the images!

Note that I've omitted the ordnance variations in order to save space (this is quite a big pack!). If you want grenade launchers or missile launchers, grab the bits from my other models and kitbash them on!

Check out the "_standoffs" version. The models' feet are offset from the plug, allowing you to use the plug as a stand when painting, and then slice or snip off the small cylinders to allow you to glue the feet directly onto the base, for a seamless finish.

Thanks to Moonjammy, Jimmyzimms and KMFP who made the original Terminuses
A BIG thanks to LSTAR, who helped me with the export script for these guys. I wouldn't be able to put out the variety I have without it!

While uploading, i noticed some of the studs are way higher detail than they need to be! Apologies! Hopefully you should be able to exclusively download the files you need, but I hope they shouldn't be too bad!

Available for Deployment!

Our tiny archeologists have returned from their expedition to the tiny tank vaults and are proud to present you the ageless classic of tiny tank warfare - Sturmpanzer Mel! Named in honour of the ancient worthy, who for his skill in CAD was awarded the prestigious title of "CADor" - Mel the CADor is your number 1 choice for trench combat, prolonged sieges and general attritional warfare. The sturdy hull is provided with numerous options including:

- two different extra fuel tanks
- trench rails
- roof mounted searchlight

Furthermore our decoration team furnished optional imperial insignia to be affixed on prominent locations of your tank.

Autocannons, Laser Cannons, Heavy Gyrojets and a mighty Siege Howitzer are provided for sponson and hull mounts. The durable casemate can mount either a powerful cannon, long barreled tank killer cannon or a dual laser cannons.

In addition to that a specialized Protector variant is provided fully festooned with anti personnel weaponry for those hectic Mondays.

Furthermore all roof hatches are rendered fully operational so that you can always fulfil your urge to catch that fragrant smell of phosgene in the air.

Sturmpanzer Mel represents an exciting new chassis to be added to our tiny tank offering and is perfect for vehicular combat in 6 to 8mm scales!

‘Isurus pattern’ Warhound Titan armour, Traitor allegiance, made to fit the Adeptus Titanicus Warhound Titan.

This is a full set of armour plates, to give your Warhounds a whole new look.
Are you are Loyalist player? Then check out the loyalist-themed version here:
https://cults3d.com/:2382548

Looking for a version with a plain, unaligned trim? Then go here:
https://cults3d.com/:2382534

Carapace and Groin plate STLs have recesses for 5x2x0.5mm magnets, with 2mm dia magnet holes in the Shoulder plate, for easy magnetising. Shin plate features clip to hold in securely. Thigh plate fits into existing gap on the titan skeleton.

Files included: STL, pre-supported STL and Lychee scenes (in the ZIP file) - should you want/need to tweak the supports for your particular printer.

Notes:
This is for the 8mm, AT2018 version.
STLs and supported STLs are for left side versions only of the shoulder and thigh plates. Shin plate is symmetrical, and so can be mirrored or just copied. These should be copied and/or mirrored to produce the right side plates, when printing your full set.
Also included in the ZIP is a Lychee file that has all the plates, as well as the appropriate duplicated/mirrored parts, within the scene too - this is the file appended ‘...Full Scene’)

Description :

1
2
3
4
5

Prepare for the arrival of the Dread Forces of CHAOX! CHAOX is a faction of those who are torn between being exact copies of the Imperious Forces and being spiky emo Goth kids. This dichotomy puts them into a permanently violent mood, causing them to descend upon the Imperious worlds and wreak havoc. In the infamous Battle of Nowherius, CHAOX forces covertly swapped the Imperious Forces' regular coffee for decaf. The casualty count reached the low billions. Billions!

The CHAOX Hellifiknow is a ground-attack fighter built for one specific thing: killing tanks! Built around a wicked, heavy, tri-barrel, armor-piercing, plasma-core, sustainably-sourced, fair trade, dolphin-safe, hand-crafted artisanal autocannon, the Hellifiknow swoops down on enemy armor and rips it to pieces! Easy to print, FDM-friendly Pillbug (land isopods, roly-polys, etc) companions!

These are meant for tabletop roleplaying games such as D&D, Pathfinder, etc, but can be used for whatever you wish.

These giant fantasy isopods (don't at me about anatomy) are available in multiple flavors, including smooth, saddled, and cannoned.

The cannon prints separately (print the cannon oriented vertically with the mouth touching the build plate) and snaps into place, and includes a small prop crate of cannonballs.

They have been sized as Medium-sized (fits on a 1 inch / 25.4mm round base) creatures, but if you scale them up by about 150% they would work fine as Large creatures (Fits on a 2 inch / 50.8mm round base).

They print with minimal supports and should be quite sturdy, even with a 0.4mm nozzle.
They will look best printed in resin, or with a 0.2mm nozzle for fine details.
Example prints were printed at 0.16mm layer heights with a 0.4mm nozzle.

Simple supports will be needed on the cannon pivot points; be sure to cut or file down the contact point with supports.

Do It Yourself (DIY) terrain scenery for WH40k. This "Knight's Gate" is 150mm X 202mm / 5.9" X 7.95" (Width and Height). It can be affixed on a wall and closed, or you can use both sides to create a gate that opens.

**Iota-HU, Pickup Truck**

This file is another remix/remaster of a file made by [TheDude21](https://www.thingiverse.com/thedude21/designs) (check him out and give him a tip, if you like). Much like the previous Glade-S, I very much liked the core Cyberpunk stylings of this vehicle concept and thought that it would make a nice adaption into a 'lower' tech level universe setting as a civilian hovercraft vehicle at the 6mm scale setting.

**About the Design.** Despite the superficial resemblance's to the original design, this project actually took quite a lot of time to remaster, because I wanted to remove as many of the 'hard-angle' edges as possible. This should make the model much better to orientate for supports and 3D print on a resin system. (zoom right in on the file to compare it with the original, if you like!)

**Other Designs.** This model set is intended to be compatible with the other 6mm (true-scale) and Hex(33) (hex scale) SciFi terrain sets that I have released on [Cults 3D](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Shiaic3D/creations) and other locations, [GumRoad](https://shiaic3d.gumroad.com/), [Printables](https://www.printables.com/@Shiaic3D/models) and [Thingiverse](https://www.thingiverse.com/shiaic1/designs).

Please search my other designs for more models of a similar type and theme.

****************
**Creativity Powered by Patreon.** This model is a remix of free files and parts available elsewhere. However, the time and effort to remix them into a model set like this were enabled with the support of my generous [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/Shiaic3D) backers, who gain exclusive access to remixes like this for a temporary period well before it is released wider.

**Glade-S, civilian HC**

This file is a remix & remaster of a file originally made by [Pietia](https://www.thingiverse.com/Pietia). I had looked at this 28mm scale model Cyberpunk Sci-Fi car and thought that it would be a cool design to adapt and remix as a civilian-model Sci-Fi hover car for use at 6mm scale.

**About the Design.** I have taken the original 3D model by Pieta and remastered it slightly, adapting it more for the 6mm scale size where some of the detail at 28mm scale was either redundant or required some further adjusting to account for detail creep or dissolution (if printed). I then created the Hovercraft 'skirt' separately and melded these two main feature components together. Finally, I created some other new detail features as well as further adjusting some of the existing features to bring it all together more holistically as an integrated overall design that works on its own.

And voila! hopefully, it does.

**Other Designs.** This model set is intended to be compatible with the other 6mm (true-scale) and Hex(33) (hex scale) SciFi terrain sets that I have released on [Cults 3D](https://cults3d.com/en/users/Shiaic3D/creations) and other locations, [GumRoad](https://shiaic3d.gumroad.com/), [Printables](https://www.printables.com/@Shiaic3D/models) and [Thingiverse](https://www.thingiverse.com/shiaic1/designs).

Please search my other designs for more models of a similar type and theme.

All credit for the creation of and permission to distribute these models goes to sentinel3 https://cults3d.com/en/users/sentinel3/3d-models. He not only allowed me to heavily modify and provide them to you for free, but allowed the medium bird to be provided which is not publicly available otherwise.

I have taken the original designs and spent dozens of hours assembling, deleting, filling, holing, and preparing these designs for 1 piece printing at a tiny scale. Some things like the big guns and fins were thickened but the front end of the big bird is significantly different than the original. The angle has been lowered and the entirety lengthened. If you are unhappy with that change you are welcome to download the original from sentinel and modify it yourself.

Inside you find both hunter and raider variant of the big bird and normal, ace, and no gun variants of the medium bird. They are all provided in 8mm scale and 6mm scale versions. They are provided without base holes and with hawk widget (standard 3mm) holes. Additionally the 8mm versions also have additional models with holes cut for notaeronautica ball joint. The medium bird is also provided with the ventral cannon separately should you wish to kitbash in your own belly gun.

Hope to see some people paint these up for their collections. Enjoy!

Disordered Galactic Crusaders, with a variety of armour types, mish-mashed together, scavenged, and modified for having fought a very long war indeed.

Comes with many poses, and five variants of each, to give variety across an army.

Weapons available are heavy machinegun, autocannons, laser cannon, chaingun and missile launchers.

Check out the "_standoffs" version. The models' feet are offset from the plug, allowing you to use the plug as a stand when painting, and then slice or snip off the small cylinders to allow you to glue the feet directly onto the base, for a seamless finish.

Thanks to Moonjammy, DangitBlobby and JimmyZimms for the base models, the Ball Bearing Armour and Beaky Armour, on which this is based.
A BIG thanks to LSTAR, who helped me with the export script for these guys. I wouldn't be able to put out the variety I have without it!

If you have any requests or would like to comission a remix, please let me know!

Six light Missile Launchers for beakies for the Badass Tyrant's War. Six unique poses of the later style tube missile launcher with the original style armor, fully kitted out with ammo backpack and a pistol holster. One for each of your tactical squads in your battle companies.

These are a full rebuild and remix of the classic Galactic Crusaders models. Thanks to Moonjammy, DangitBobby and JimmyZimms for the base models, and Daffmakes for the builder and assets.

This is a passion project, so please let me know if there are any issues with the files or if you have other ideas for units or weapons to go with this expanding addition to the Galactic Crusaders family.

These are meant to be used for the post Heresy era setting, and in particular, the Bad Ass Tyrant's War campaign. As such the weapon era, look, and loadouts all reflect that. These could easily be used for Heresy though.

Update: One guy was missing the ammo rack for his backpack, so I gave it to him. Sorry little buddy! Now he doesn't have to bum missiles off his brothers. 

"Brother, could I uhh... trouble you for uhhh... "

An expanded set for Tactical Galactic Crusaders, with Gloomy Flavour in multiple armour marks, including Segmented, Boarding, Plate, New Style Ball Bearing and New Style Beaky.
Now with robes for your monastic, knightly or fashion conscious space lads.

Each pose has an option of a tabard, robe, or a hooded robe.

Weapons available are rifles with two types of bayonet, plasma, flamethrower, magma gun, heat ray, and gravitic rifles. Pretty much any option you could want in a rifle carrying future guy!

Tactical Galactic Crusaders in a variety of poses, including Sergeants, Radio, Grenade-throwing, Scanner, and Back banner as add-ons for some additional variation.

Check out the "_standoffs" version. The models' feet are offset from the plug, allowing you to use the plug as a stand when painting, and then slice or snip off the small cylinders to allow you to glue the feet directly onto the base, for a seamless finish.

Thanks to Moonjammy, DangitBlobby and JimmyZimms for the base models, the Ball Bearing Armour and Beaky Armour, on which this is based.
A BIG thanks to LSTAR, who helped me with the export script for these guys. I wouldn't be able to put out the variety I have without it!

A complete collection of retro-themed Gothic Ruins for table top gaming. These are the full set of 20 ruins that make up the full set of the sample set released earlier, available here: https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/retro-gothic-corner-ruins-set-1

Included in this set are 20 corner ruins, the floor piece for the raised platform on the two tallest corner ruins, plus two floor templates in case anyone wants to break them up a bit for some floor details on the ground level.

Inspired by the cardboard terrain I used in my youth, these turn those 2D flat terrain pieces into fully 3D models, to look more fitting on a modern gaming table!

Scaled to suit 28mm-32mm models, I actually designed them to be printed out at 50% scale for 15mm gaming. They even work well all the way down to 25% scale for 8mm gaming!

Perfect for reliving past wargaming experiences, or for giving your current games a bit of a Retro theme!

Please check out my other wargaming models including the first part of this set, and if you like this set, please consider liking the file, following me, or even making a donation! I love seeing what people do with my models, so please post a make once you've printed them out. I am an amateur, hobby-level designer, and any support helps keep me motivated and supports the hobby activities I can do! Thanks!

Rumbling forward on heavy tracks, the tanks of the Imperial Army are capable of decimating enemy forces with overwhelming firepower. The versatile main battle tank hull is capable of being adapted to feature a wide range of alternate patterns - including devastating artillery.

This set of 79 STLS, and features the heavy 'Bombardier' tank, the long range 'Basil' tank, and the medium 'Euryale' tank, each with variants with and without bulldozer blade, and variants with holes onto which plastic open hatches from comparable plastic tank kits are compatible. There are also additional hull variants, of each tank, including an Imperial Army Bombardier tank, and hulls with extra armour, plus some kit form Bombardiers. Also included are a range of an optional details, including rear-mounted mounted dozer blade (enabling the artillery to 'dig in' prior to firing), rear mounted trailers, support struts, and shells that can be used to add features to any bases you wish to mount the tanks on.

This set has been made to be compatible with 8mm scale main line battle tanks of the Imperial Army in a recently released 8mm grim-dark future wargame.

Please see my other items for a free sample of this set, and a range of other 8mm scale and other wargames and hobby models. I am an enthusiastic amateur designer, self and video-tutorial taught, so am always open to constructive feedback.

Please consider liking the design and posting a make.

A humble reworking of Moonjammy's excellent designs, optimised for stackable printing.

Love printing little dudes but hate having to get up every hour to scrape off your build plate, waste good resin in your wash station, and restart the print? Then here's the new easy-to-use stacking solution you've been waiting for! Stack small objects vertically to fit into your print schedule, or efficiently fill left over build plate volume when printing taller objects.

Including:
- **Galactic Crusader Infantry in Heavy Siege Armour** with a choice of Boxing Gloves or Hedge Trimmers and a selection of heavy weaponry
- Arranged in pre-built stacks of 12, 18 and 24.
- Raw components and a guide for creating custom stacks

**Scale and Sizing:**
The Galactic Crusaders in this pack have been resized to 105%.
This makes the average Galactic Crusader ~9.5mm tall (varying based on pose and armour style), and the base plugs 6.16x1.31mm.

**Want to know more about Floating Rafts and you can use them to convert your own models into stackable designs?**
Check out the [Floating Raft Stackable Conversion System](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/art/starports-floating-rafts-stackable-conversion-system)!

*Like what I'm doing? [Buy me a cup of resin!](https://ko-fi.com/lstar)* 😁

Stack small objects vertically to fit into your print schedule, or efficiently fill left over build plate volume when printing taller objects.

Including:
- **Galactic Crusader Infantry with Heavy Rocket Launchers** in 2egmented, 3oarding, and Pl4te armour
- Arranged in pre-built stacks of 20, 30 and 40.
- Raw components and a guide for creating custom stacks

**Scale and Sizing:**
The Galactic Crusaders in this pack have been resized to 105%.
This makes the average Galactic Crusader ~9.5mm tall (varying based on pose and armour style), and the base plugs 6.16x1.31mm.

Other unit such as immortal, flayers might get added later on. No scarabs for very obvious reason.

Rumbling forward on heavy tracks, the tanks of the Imperial Army are capable of decimating enemy forces with overwhelming firepower. The versatile main battle tank is capable of being adapted to feature a wide range of alternate patterns - support vehicles capable of hauling damaged vehicles or artillery, hulls with sponsons, dozer blades and ram bars.

This is a single hull sample of a set of tank hulls featuring 8 base hull designs - The full set contains a Destroyer hull, Thunderer hull, Flamer hull, laser cannon hull, heavy bolt hull, automatic cannon hull, and two support variant hulls. Each of these come with bulldozer blade and ram bar options. Each of the standard tank hull designs also comes with options for two different sponson designs (square and inset versions) , with holes for magnetisation. Included in the main set are also two turret options, to create complete tanks. For a sample turret, please see my other designs.

This sample hull has been made to be compatible with 8mm scale main line battle tanks of the Imperial Army in a recently released 8mm grim-dark future wargame. They feature a magnet hole, and a peg compatible with existing plastic model turrets.

This sample is free. For the full set, I've priced it cheaply, but priced it as a reflection of the time I took to create such an extensive set. I deeply appreciate all those who support and encourage my work by buying any of my paid designs.

Please see my other items for a free sample of this set, and a range of other 8mm scale and other wargames and hobby models, including a set of compatible turret options for these tanks. I am an enthusiastic amateur designer, self and video-tutorial taught, so am always open to constructive feedback.

Please consider liking the design and posting a make.

Hey Hey, Been a while hasn't it. I'm back from a long trip in southern Asia so naturally I come back home and open up blender to see if i still got it.

This is a modification for Tersus's Gorkabot (https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/gorkabot). Send the original creator some love. Their work is incredible and part of the reason I got into 3D modelling in the first place.

What have I done? Basically a conversion into the Morkabot variant. But wait there's more! I've fully supported up the model. Which fits comfortably on to just 3 Saturn 2 build plates.

A lot of you have probably downloaded this model and haven't had the time to support it, so here you go. I'm fairly decent at supporting but a bit rusty so there may be some mistakes so make sure to run it through UV tools.

V2 Update
-Magnetized all arm and weapon connection points.
-Added tons of new arm/weapon/Bitz styles
-Fixed a few meshes errors
-Made an attempt to allow the doors to open and pivot.
-Combined meshes to optimize printing in resin.

This is a remix of the impressive STROGANOFF original Epic Scale Landing Craft found at https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/epic-scale-landing-craft. As I wanted to print it on FDM I modified it to have the less non-fdm printable detail removed (turrets, landing gear) and those details later printed in a resin printer for accuracy.
There is some work in the lateral clamps as I have added a 4mm magnet slot and modified the width to fit new rhinos/big grimdark containers.

* 2024-02-10 Update: Add missing lower rear reactor piece and update renders

I have explicitly asked STROGANOFF for modifying and sharing this asset. Be respectful with your fellow artists :)

A humble reworking of Speacock and THEWRAETHTHU's excellent reworking of Failtruck's (?) excellent design, optimised and cleaned up for easy printing.

"_While P.O.D. Droplets were usually synonymous with lightning assaults, one of their most infamous uses during the Hera-C involved an over-eager commander ordering the launch of a wave long before his logistics ships had made it into orbit._

_When the P.O.D.s finally made planetfall some six months later, the confused defenders found nothing inside but dust and emaciated corpses..._"

- Reassembled and repaired: No more voids!
- Hollowed for efficient printing: Including rafts and supports, small P.O.D.s use ~3.8ml of resin, large P.O.D.s use ~5.4ml of resin
- Includes supported and unsupported STLs and Lychee scenes for tweaking

Rumbling forward on heavy tracks, the tanks of the Imperial Army are capable of decimating enemy forces with overwhelming firepower. The versatile main battle tank is capable of being adapted to house a great range of weaponry, ensuring the right tool is available to tackle any foe. Whether busting bunkers, demolishing buildings, bathing entrenched foes in flames or caustic chemicals, or melting through armour plate, there is a turret for every occasion.

This is a sample turret from my full set of tank turrets featuring 15 weapon options, plus two with additional coaxial cannons, making a total of 17 weapon load outs. Each of those comes with optional designs, making this set of over 60 STLs!

Find the full set here: https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/8mm-scale-grim-dark-tank-turrets-of-russ-nedius

This turret has been made to be compatible with 8mm scale main line battle tanks of the Imperial Army in a recently released 8mm grim-dark future wargame. It features a magnet hole, and a peg compatible with existing plastic model hulls.

I've provided this free sample to support those hobbyists who want an turret option, and are happy with just that one option! However, the full set is priced very cheaply! I deeply appreciate all those who support and encourage my work by buying any of my paid designs.

Please see my other items for the full version of this set, and a range of other 8mm scale and other wargames and hobby models. I am an enthusiastic amateur designer, self and video-tutorial taught, so am always open to constructive feedback.

Please consider liking the design and posting a make.

Rumbling forward on heavy tracks, the tanks of the Imperial Army are capable of decimating enemy forces with overwhelming firepower. The versatile main battle tank is capable of being adapted to house a great range of weaponry, ensuring the right tool is available to tackle any foe. Whether busting bunkers, demolishing buildings, bathing entrenched foes in flames or caustic chemicals, or melting through armour plate, there is a turret for every occasion.

This is a set of tank turrets featuring 15 weapon options, plus two with additional coaxial cannons, making a total of 17 weapon load outs. Each of those comes with optional designs, making this set of over 60 STLs!

These have been made to be compatible with 8mm scale main line battle tanks of the Imperial Army in a recently released 8mm grim-dark future wargame. They feature a magnet hole, and a peg compatible with existing plastic model hulls. The 'open hatch' designs (usually noted as designs A or C) fit the plastic hatch options for the same main battle tank, allowing for use of spare bits and personalisation. Options B and D usually feature build-in closed hatches for those who want to keep things simple. There are also two slightly different desings, allowing for some variety in turret apperance (A and B are design 1, C and D design 2) as well as designs with fuel barrels or energy generators.

The weapon options are:

Battle cannon
Vanquishing cannon
Building Demolisher cannon
Twin laser cannons
Twin light cannons
Plasma cannon
Punishing Gatling cannon
Incinerating energy cannon
Eradicating heavy cannon
Conqueror medium cannon
Huntsman flamer cannon
Twin heavy bolt gun
Chemical cannon
Melta cannon
Anti-aircraft flak cannon (fixed + posable versions)


Also included is a static bunker turret emplacement, allowing spare turrets to be added to your battlefield as terrain or support artillery.

I've priced this cheaply, but priced it as a reflection of the time I took to create such an extensive set. I deeply appreciate all those who support and encourage my work by buying any of my paid designs.

Please see my other items for a free sample of this set, and a range of other 8mm scale and other wargames and hobby models. I am an enthusiastic amateur designer, self and video-tutorial taught, so am always open to constructive feedback.

Let's face it: Even in the far future, people are still obsessed with efficiency, doing more with less. So it is with maintaining the Imperious Leader's far-flung dominion, and the most efficient method of moving stuff is still the train. And when you have enemies, those trains make sweet, juicy targets, necessitating adding arms and armor to repel the bad guys.

This set includes not only nine different train cars, but compatible track segments. The various train cars have round guide lugs on the underside that serve to keep the cars centered on the tracks.

The GothiTech Armored Train includes:

- Armed Locomotive
- Flatbed Car
- Boxcar
- Tanker Car
- Passenger Car
- Nuclear Fuel Car
- Artillery Car (cannon prints separately and can be mounted up for firing or down for travel)
- Troop Car (includes mounting points for two turrets)
- Air Defense Car (includes two antiaircraft missile turrets)
- Five Track Segments (Straight Single, Curved Single, Y-Split, Straight Double, and Curved Double)

How hungry are they?
So hungry they could eat an entire planet.

Variety of chainaxe wielding maniacs in segmented armour pattern.
Comes with regular helm, Sarum helm, and Hungry Boys Veteran helm for all pose types.

Extra variety can be gotten by mirroring the various poses. In particular with the dual and two-handed chainaxe variants.

For the flying marines, they have holes in the jump pack to accept a 1mm rod as a flight stand. For my example (see my generic assault marines), I cut halfway along the curve of a paperclip, inserted the curved end into the hole with a bit of superglue and adjusted the tilt of the marine from there. Then, drill a hole into your base of choice, and adjust the height of the paperclip as desired.

There is also a "_standoffs" version. This is something I'm playing around with where the models' feet are offset from the plug, allowing you to use the plug as a stand when painting, and then slice or snip off the small cylinders to allow you to glue the feet directly onto the base, for a seamless finish.

If you'd rather adjust the placement of the rods yourself for use with straight brass rod, or clear acrylic rods, I've provided the "_nohole" versions for this purpose.

Thanks to Moonjammy for the excellent original models!

If you like what I'm doing, please donate to my Ko-Fi!
https://ko-fi.com/daffmakes

Ok, so there are many ways to confiture the Malc, so here are a few of them. I did variants based on the combinations of the mainguns (Vanquisher, Battle Cannon, and Double LasCans with 3 different hull guns (lascanon, HvyBolter, Demolisher) and the 2 different sponsons of Autocannons and LasCans.

These STLs have been painstakingly repaired/ filled and then had the underneath scooped out to reduce suction.

Now, if the one you are seeking doesn't quite exist, just open them into 3D builder and cut/paste to your hearts desire. Its pretty easy - plenty of tutorials on the tube of YOU.

These models are all ultimately based on Danny_Cyanide's work. They were reduced in scale and assembled by Korgaan, but had a lot of internal hollow (especially around the sides/ tracks) that needed to be filled. I did a ton of repair work. Other creators have worked on these prior, but I noticed there were still internal hollows, so the ones here should be a better print with a lower chance of resin leakage - it is difficult to take multi-part STLs and assemble a single print model without some stuff missed - so this is not in any way a criticism of those fine works.

There are 8 tanks here:
BattleTurret with AutoCannonSpn and HvyBolterHull
BattleTurret with LasCannonSpn and HvyBolterHull
BattleTurret with LasCannonSpn and DemolisherHull
DblLasCaneTurret with LasCannonSpn and DemolisherHull
DblLasCaneTurret with LasCannonSpn and HvyBolterHull
DblLasCaneTurret with LasCannonSpn and LascanonHull
VanqTurret with LasCannonSpn and DemolisherHull
VanqTurret with LasCannonSpn and LascanonHull

This posting is not in anyway an invite for "aktually - sniff - blah blah blah" type of comments. People that think that way are typically not the subject matter experts they want to be on the internets. Either get off the internet or if you can do it better - do it.

I do not recall where I grabbed this Arvus Lighter model from. I think it was an unattributed free source (jimmyjimjim reposted it). It came from somewhere and when I find out where, I'll add attribution.

Some idiot STL Stasi type will undoubtedly have an issue with that. Shut up. Either help me or go take a giant leap at a rolling donut.

Now - to the important stuff. I've not test printed this one but it is a very simple model in very good shape with no hollows to trap resin and the walls are pretty thick. The magnet slot (5mm) is inside on the roof and set at about a 3-5 degree angle down (can't remember) so the Arvus Lighter have a nose down look to it like a modern helo at cruising speed.

I hollowed and opened up the internals so that it can be properly UV light cured and left the door open in case someone wants to put a gunner back there :)

The wingspan is about 40mm, so I think it looks about right compared to what I have seen for the AI/LImp one. Resize as needed but be prepared to use a smaller magnet

OK, just a scooped, supported and magnet ready version of Wolfkeeper's GRIMDARK MINUTE FLYING ARMED TRANSPORT and nitramthx's burning little dino for galactic crusaders. They are great little free files and will work well at 8mm. I sized them to have roughly a 70mm wingspan, but size however you like, just be cognicent that resizing circles can make ovals.

I removed the lower floor of the model, so the magent insert is on the roof of the model and can accept magnets up to 10mm - so pick your poison.

I also did some editing to make sure there were no resin captures.

These models are not hollowed in the traditional sense - no resin can be captured and all internals can be exposed to UV light for curing. Some idiot will not look at the files and mis-understand that and will invariably do an "aktuallly blah blah blah" - it always seems to happen....

Each pin has slots for a normal sponson weapon and a 2x1mm neodymium magnet.

A slightly unhinged reworking of Moonjammy's excellent design, optimised for _crazy_ printing!

A new concept for creating simple, stackable supports for Epic scale infantry! Use the supplied STLs or easily create blocks of infantry in any arbitrary width and height simply by copying strips in Lychee and moving them vertically, no additional fine-tuning required!

**ARE STACKABLE SUPPORTS RIGHT FOR ME?**

Stackable supports are slightly less resin-efficient compared with printing a single squad flat on the build plate, but time and clean-up efficient, allowing you to print large numbers of troops in a single print without having to get up to scrape them off the build plate, clean up, and restart your print every hour!

Stackable supports also allow you to make effective use of empty space on your build plate when printing larger vehicles or 28mm scale models. Just create a stack as tall as your other models!

**UH OH, THIS LOOKS COMPLICATED! IS REMOVING THE SUPPORTS HARD?**

De-supporting these is easy and risk free!
The heavy supports only make contact with the pseudo-rafts so you can yank them off without any worries. Then just use a knife tip or tweezer to pick off the remaining supports on the individual models.

*Love playing games with hidden orders but hate faffing around with flimsy carboard tokens?
Streamline your games of Legions Imperialis (or Epic!) with these X-Wing-style order dials!
Just add two 3x2mm neodymium magnets and get scheming!*

Note: This is a bit of an open beta for dial designs I've been working on recently.
If other people like these as much as I do, I'll release a full range, covering other games, and fancy designs to suit various factions and armies.
Let me know how you get on printing these, if you run into any problems, or have any suggestions for making them better!


**How should I print these?**

These dials are supported for easy and high-quality vertical printing on a resin printer.
Unsupported versions are included in case this doesn't suit you.

Aligned vertically, layer height is more important for fine detail than your printer's XY resolution, so these designs should print nicely even on older printers! I recommend using a 0.03mm layer height.

**How should I remove these weird supports?**

Like other supports, warm them up with some warm water or a heat gun before removal. Wiggle the supports back and forth and they should pop off.

In most cases this should leave next to no support marks, but if a small amount of material is left on the disc, rub them gently with some sandpaper, or scrape them with a knife/mouldline remover.

**Why are there 5 versions of the lower discs? Aren't they exactly the same?**

This is to prevent any mentats or Alpha Legion infiltrators you happen to play against from trying to predict your orders by analysing icon or support mark orientation!

**Any painting tips?**

Option 1: Paint the dials and use a pinwash to pick out the symbols and text. Oil washes work great for this!

Option 2: Paint the dials and drybrush/overbrush the raised surfaces with another colour, leaving your original colour in the recesses.

**Any tips for reducing wear and tear?**

These things are going to get handled, tossed about and rubbed together over the course of a game!

I recommend giving your paint plenty of time to fully dry unjoined before use, and to apply a good coat of varnish!

**Are you going to make a version for my favourite army/game system?**

Yep, I've already designed dials for other games like Epic, Battlefleet Gothic and Aeronautica Imperialis, and themes for a number of popular armies. If the feedback for this pack is good, I'll release others in due course!

**I don't want to wait. Can I make my own versions?**

Sure, feel free to remix the Blank version for personal use.

*Like what I'm doing? [Buy me a cup of resin!](https://ko-fi.com/lstar)* 😁

+++ Berserks units are made up from assault squads of the mos ferocious hand-to-hand fighters in the Stronghold. Armed with bolt pistols and power axes, theyre experts tunnel fighters and excel at clearing buildings and fortifications ahead of the Brotherhood´s advance. All squats are doughty fighters in close combat, but the Berserks units are renowed for their tneacity and courage against even the mightiest opponents without thought for their own looses.

By tradition, Berserkers often wear a striking crest dyed bright red, which is why they refuse to wear combat helmets. The origins of this practice have been lost in the mists of time, but what for many Imperial officers could be an absurd and tactically reprehensible risk, for the Squats is definitive proof of the courage of the Berserkers and their attitude of always spitting in death´s face.+++

I have had these models ready for quite some time, and in fact I also have them printed, but due to lack of time I have not been able to mount and paint them properly to take nice pics.

As I am currently focused on finishing my squat miners (among other lesser things such as graduating from university), I don't think I will resume my Epic Squats in the short term, so I have decided to upload these Berserkers models once and for all and thus finish the infantry forces at least.

Finally this guys come in two flavours: with a boltpistol/power axe combo, and the classic dual wield boltpistols. This is a simple aestetic choice to give variety to the squads.

This locally-produced heavy fighter, distantly related to the more commonly encountered Thunderbolt, featured heavily in the closing days of the imperial civil war. With poor maneuverability at low altitudes and a dangerously exposed propulsion system, the craft was poorly suited for ground attack work. However, its speed and performance at high altitudes, combined with a pair of lethally accurate long-barreled autocannons made the fighter especially dangerous when either escorting or intercepting bombers and reconnaissance aircraft. Fighting on both sides during the conflict, it was ultimately a shortage of pilots with combat experience that led to horrific casualty rates among its pilots.

Compatible with any 8mm scale wargame. Fits most standard flight stands. Comes in air and ground versions with a variety of ordnance.
